_comment: Owner alerts for Accaza production (accaza-sartoga). Applied by tools/apply-monitoring-alerts.ps1, which attaches every notification channel whose display name starts with 'Danilo'. Phone numbers never live in this public repository. Log-match alerts read Cloud Logging only: no Firebase reads, downloads or function calls. tests/monitoring-alerts-check.mjs fails if a log message these filters depend on is renamed or removed.

policies.filter: severity>=ERROR AND jsonPayload.deadLetter:* AND jsonPayload.message:"Retry budget exhausted"
policies.subject: Accaza: background task stopped (${log.extracted_label.function})
policies.doc:
A server task kept failing and stopped retrying to protect the database. The till keeps selling.

**Do now:** open Admin > System Health and press **Run health check now**. Sales-history tasks repair themselves on that check; posting tasks show what to complete.

**Do not** re-enter any sale.

policies.subject: Accaza: database backup failed
policies.doc:
Tonight's database backup did not finish (6-12 Oct 2026 it ran out of memory seven nights in a row unnoticed).

**Do now:** in Admin run a manual backup (Run database backup now). If it fails again, the backup function needs a fix before the next night. Live data is unaffected.

policies.displayName: Accaza CRITICAL - Server function out of memory
policies.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND severity>=ERROR AND textPayload:"Memory limit of" AND -resource.labels.service_name="backupdatabasedaily" AND -resource.labels.service_name="rundatabasebackupnow"
policies.subject: Accaza: ${log.extracted_label.service} ran out of memory
policies.doc:
A server function crashed because its data outgrew its memory. Its work was not completed and will usually be retried.

**Do now:** open System Health and run a health check; ask Claude/Codex to raise that function's memory.

policies.displayName: Accaza CRITICAL - Finance safety guard tripped
policies.filter: severity>=ERROR AND (jsonPayload.message:"Unsafe atomic update blocked" OR (jsonPayload.message:"Financial operation failed" AND jsonPayload.expected=false))
policies.subject: Accaza: finance safety guard tripped
policies.doc:
A Finance Books write was refused because it could not be made safely, or a posting crashed unexpectedly. Nothing half-posted: the guard blocks the whole write.

**Do now:** note what staff were doing at that time, then open Finance Books > Controls audit.

policies.displayName: Accaza CRITICAL - POS sale not saved
policies.filter: severity>=ERROR AND jsonPayload.message:"POS sale not saved"
policies.subject: Accaza: POS sale not saved
policies.doc:
The server refused a till sale (permanent error, 3 failed tries or 5 minutes). The till still holds it in its queue.

**Do now:** Admin > Register Ops > Sales needing recovery. Recover or dismiss it. Do not ring it up again.
